Game Overview

Drop Dunks is a basketball title where bounce, aim, and score in Drop Dunks. Control a platform to deflect balls into baskets for points, while three dispensers challenge your reflexes. Strategically upgrade to new balls and cannons. It's basketball with a twist—where quick thinking and precision are your best teammates. Dive in and dominate the court!
